description: PostgreSQL 18 type-aware statistics, sorting, hashing, operator-class catalogs, default selection, explicit selection, and validation
cleanup_sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS type_matrix_type_planner CASCADE;
DROP DOMAIN IF EXISTS type_matrix_money_amount CASCADE;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS type_matrix_work_state CASCADE;
sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM pg_catalog.pg_opclass WHERE oid < 16384;
SELECT oid, opcmethod, opcname::text, opcnamespace, opcowner, opcfamily, opcintype, opcdefault, opckeytype FROM pg_catalog.pg_opclass WHERE oid < 16384 ORDER BY oid;
SELECT count(*) AS count FROM pg_catalog.pg_opfamily WHERE oid < 16384;
SELECT oid, opfmethod, opfname::text, opfnamespace, opfowner FROM pg_catalog.pg_opfamily WHERE oid < 16384 ORDER BY oid;
SELECT count(*) AS count FROM pg_catalog.pg_amop WHERE oid < 16384;
SELECT oid, amopfamily, amoplefttype, amoprighttype, amopstrategy, amoppurpose::text, amopopr, amopmethod, amopsortfamily FROM pg_catalog.pg_amop WHERE oid < 16384 ORDER BY oid;
SELECT count(*) AS count FROM pg_catalog.pg_amproc WHERE oid < 16384;
SELECT oid, amprocfamily, amproclefttype, amprocrighttype, amprocnum, amproc::oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_amproc WHERE oid < 16384 ORDER BY oid;
CREATE TYPE type_matrix_work_state AS ENUM ('open', 'closed');
CREATE DOMAIN type_matrix_money_amount AS numeric CHECK (VALUE >= 0);

CREATE TABLE type_matrix_type_planner (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, amount numeric, domain_amount type_matrix_money_amount, owner_id uuid, tags text[], payload jsonb, span int4range, state type_matrix_work_state, xml_doc xml);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_type_planner_amount_idx ON type_matrix_type_planner (amount);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_type_planner_domain_idx ON type_matrix_type_planner (domain_amount);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_type_planner_owner_idx ON type_matrix_type_planner USING hash (owner_id);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_type_planner_tags_idx ON type_matrix_type_planner USING gin (tags);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_type_planner_payload_idx ON type_matrix_type_planner USING gin (payload jsonb_path_ops);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_type_planner_span_idx ON type_matrix_type_planner USING gist (span);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_type_planner_state_idx ON type_matrix_type_planner (state);
SELECT c.relname::text, i.indclass::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_index AS i JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid WHERE c.relname LIKE 'type_matrix_type_planner_%_idx' ORDER BY c.relname;
ANALYZE type_matrix_type_planner;

SELECT attname::text, null_frac, n_distinct, avg_width > 0 AS has_width, (most_common_vals IS NOT NULL OR histogram_bounds IS NOT NULL) AS has_distribution, pg_typeof(most_common_vals)::text, pg_typeof(histogram_bounds)::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_stats WHERE tablename = 'type_matrix_type_planner' AND attname IN ('amount', 'domain_amount', 'owner_id', 'tags', 'state') ORDER BY attname;
SELECT amount::text, count(*) AS count FROM type_matrix_type_planner GROUP BY amount ORDER BY amount;
SELECT owner_id::text FROM type_matrix_type_planner ORDER BY owner_id DESC;
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_type_planner_xml_idx ON type_matrix_type_planner (xml_doc);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_type_planner_wrong_idx ON type_matrix_type_planner (owner_id numeric_ops);
